description.zh: 向人格提问时用哪个模型。宿主按 插件覆盖值 > 所选 provider > 全局默认 逐字段解析
description.en: The model a persona answers through. The host resolves it field by field as plugin override > selected provider > global default

hint.zh: 留空使用全局默认。下拉列表来自这套部署实际配置的 provider
hint.en: Empty uses the global default. The list comes from what this deployment actually has configured

hint.zh: 留空则沿用所选 provider 的模型；人格提示词较长，建议用上下文窗口大一些的模型
hint.en: Empty keeps the selected provider's model. A persona prompt is long, so prefer a model with room for it

hint.zh: 人格本身已经带足够的风格，温度不必调高
hint.en: The persona already supplies the voice; this does not need to be high

hint.zh: 单次模型请求最多等多久。0 表示沿用所选 provider 的超时；咨询工具的外层超时自动跟着它走
hint.en: How long one model request may take. 0 keeps the provider's own timeout; the consult tool's outer timeout follows it

description.zh: 279 位人格都能被搜索和阅读；这里决定规划器能直接路由到哪几个部门
description.en: All 279 personas are searchable and readable. This decides which divisions the planner can route to directly

label.zh: 注册为子智能体的部门

hint.zh: 每个部门注册一个子智能体（如 agency_engineering_specialist）。列表越长，规划器的候选提示词越长——只留这套部署真的会用到的部门。可选值：academic、design、engineering、finance、game-development、gis、healthcare、marketing、paid-media、product、project-management、research、sales、security、spatial-computing、specialized、support、testing
hint.en: One subagent per division, e.g. agency_engineering_specialist. A longer list means a longer routing prompt, so keep the divisions this deployment actually uses. Available: academic, design, engineering, finance, game-development, gis, healthcare, marketing, paid-media, product, project-management, research, sales, security, spatial-computing, specialized, support, testing

hint.zh: 工具与页面搜索默认返回多少位人格
hint.en: How many personas a search returns by default, in the tool and on the page

hint.zh: 读取人格提示词时截断到这个长度，返回值会说明是否被截断
hint.en: A persona prompt is clipped to this when read; the result says whether it was

hint.zh: 咨询时作为 system 提示词发出去的人格长度上限。上游最长的人格约 4 万字符，全量发送很贵
hint.en: How much of a persona is sent as the system prompt. The longest upstream persona is around 40k characters, and sending all of it is expensive

hint.zh: 开启时，子智能体挑好人格后直接发一次模型请求作答；关闭时只返回人格简报，由调用方自己决定怎么用
hint.en: On, a specialist picks a persona and answers with one model request. Off, it returns the persona brief and leaves the call to the caller

hint.zh: 上游人格全部是英文写的，默认让模型跟着提问语言回答
hint.en: The upstream personas are written in English; the default asks the model to follow the question's language

hint.zh: 拼在人格提示词之前，用来加本部署自己的边界，例如禁止编造事实、必须给出可执行步骤
hint.en: Prepended to the persona prompt - where a deployment adds its own boundaries, such as no invented facts or always give runnable steps

system_prefix.default: Stay inside the persona below. Say plainly when something is outside your speciality, and never invent facts, prices or metrics.

hint.zh: 每个用户保留最近多少条咨询记录，超出的在下一次咨询后被清理
hint.en: How many consultations are kept per user; older ones are trimmed after the next consultation

description.zh: /agency-panel 组出来的小组默认长什么样。vote 至少 2 人、dialogue 恰好 2 人、consensus 最多 7 人，这是宿主编译器的硬约束
description.en: What /agency-panel assembles by default. The host's compiler requires at least 2 voters, exactly 2 dialogue participants, and at most 7 judges

hint.zh: 会按所选协作方式的上下限夹紧
hint.en: Clamped to the chosen mode's own limits

hint.zh: invisible 字段不出现在表单里，但仍进入 plugin.config，适合放迁移标记
hint.en: An invisible field is hidden from the form but still lands in plugin.config - good for migration markers
